title: Stabilize flaky batch-charge ordering test in billing-service
description:
billing-service CI has started flapping on tests/test_charges.py::test_batch_preserves_charge_order. It passes on some runs and fails on others with 'batch returned charges out of order', which blocks the billing-service pipeline and forces manual re-runs.

The intermittent failure is around process_charges_batch, which fans out the per-charge calls concurrently. Get the test reliably passing so the pipeline stops flapping.

Out of scope: the two long-standing latency-sensitive tests in the same file (test_charge_completes_within_50ms, test_concurrent_charge) flake on simulated upstream latency and are tracked separately - leave them alone.
scope: Stabilize test_batch_preserves_charge_order in billing-service so it stops flapping the pipeline
